title: Ethics and Responsibility in Agricultural Business

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept and principles of business ethics in agriculture, and the role of ethics in business operations.
Apply knowledge of CSR in agricultural business operations, and understand the responsibilities towards stakeholders.
Understand labor relations and human rights issues in agricultural businesses.
Understand the concepts, roles, and methods of sustainable agriculture.
Understand legal and regulatory frameworks related to agricultural business operations.
Develop and implement ethical and responsible business strategies in agriculture.
Participate in the development and implementation of ethical and responsible policies in agriculture.
Understand the role of consumer protection in agricultural business operations.
Understand the ethical and responsible aspects of supply chain management in agriculture.
Understand international standards and regulations related to agricultural business operations.
